sources.quote: Of 3,725 excluded clinicians identified, 16.2% (n=605) received one or more payments.
sources.searcher_note: Bachhuber, Piper, Dobbins, King: LEIE linked to Open Payments by NPI, payments during exclusion only, 2013-2024 pooled; 7,061 payments totaling $2,286,339; no 2024-only figure, no named clinicians or companies. Table 2 lists debt forgiveness at $128,438 across 5 clinicians (2013-2024).

sources.quote: Hector Molina has been the focus of numerous FOX 4 investigative reports.
sources.searcher_note: 2015 federal indictment of a North Texas doctor Hector Molina for $5M+ Medicare house-call fraud; explains a likely exclusion but says nothing about Skye Orthobiologics or industry payments. Same-person match not verified.

notes: Only research coverage of the pattern found: the JGIM 2026 study is the same measure (LEIE clinicians paid by industry during exclusion) but pooled 2013-2024, with no 2024-only count and no names. No news story found reporting it. No source links Hector Molina to Skye Orthobiologics or debt forgiveness. DOJ (justice.gov) and FBI pages on the 2015 Hector Molina indictment were found in search but blocked to fetch; Dallas Morning News 2015 page blocked by a client challenge. A bioengineer.org rewrite of the study exists but carries no numbers and was not recorded.
